d:
A small, furry creature of the Yordle species with electric orange fur and a long, bushy orange tail. Bright amber eyes with a mischievous glint. Appears as a youthful, energetic creature. Small stature, wearing a leather aviator's cap and goggles with a steampunk scrap-metal mech suit in rusted iron and brass. Three fingers and a thumb per hand.
BODY COLOR: electric orange
